confidence_notes: Restaurant benchmarks are Orlando-specific 2026 price indexes. The cocktail anchor follows a menu-price median; the wine-glass estimate uses its local price relationship to draft beer. Hostel options are sparse, current private-hostel rates were unavailable, and accommodation prices are not broken out by star class or measured across a full year.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; Orlando-specific restaurant and accommodation data were available.
